title: Chapter 55 Seeking Justice
content:
Chapter 55 Seeking Justice

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng, who had just returned to the deserted city, trembled all over in another part of the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm.

It's Xiaoxue!

The next moment, Lu Daosheng locked Lu Xue's position.

Buzz —

Lu Daosheng directly broke through the crack in the void, forced a passage, and then took a step in.

On the other side.

The patriarch of the White Bear tribe looked at Lu Xue in a daze, about to say something.

And at this moment, the entire void suddenly began to tremble.

The next moment, a void crack appeared beside the two.

A middle-aged man walked out of it.

Looking at the terrifying void turbulence in the void crack behind the man, the White Bear Clan leader was so shocked that his eyes almost fell off.

On the side, Lu Xue was already looking at the man in tears at this moment.

"Dad~"

Lu Xue choked and said.

Looking at Lu Xue, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but his eyes were slightly red.

Immediately, Lu Daosheng stepped forward and hugged Lu Xue.

"Xiaoxue, it's all bad for dad, dad should have come early."

At this moment, feeling Lu Daosheng's arms again, Lu Xue's tears could not stop flowing down.

Thousands of words have come to this day, but I can't say a word.

The two hugged each other tightly.

Only the White Bear Clan leader on the side watched all this awkwardly.

At this time, a tribe member ran towards this place.

"Clan,"

Bang!

The White Bear Clan Chief rushed up directly, covered his mouth, and pointed at Lu Daosheng and the others.

"Shh~"

That's adult's father, and it's so terrifying.

If such a strong man is not in a good mood, he will not be able to take their White Bear Clan.

It took me a long time before Lu Dao's father and daughter separated.

"Xiaoxue, let's go home."

"Uh-huh."

Lu Xue nodded obediently.

She didn't ask anything. At this moment, she just wanted to go back to the deserted city and have a good rest.

Just as the two were about to leave, Lu Xue suddenly remembered something and then pointed to the White Bear Clan.

"Dad, take them back too. They have taken good care of me over the years."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Okay, listen to you."

Then Lu Daosheng waved his hand and the entire White Bear clan directly entered Lu Daosheng's world in his palm.

The White Bear Clan will also ascend completely from today.

After returning to the deserted city.

Lu Daosheng lifted the ban on Huangcheng.

At this time, the people in the deserted city had already started to go crazy.

"Here, here!!"

"Is this the new world? It feels like the air is so fresh."

"Wuhu~ I want to go out, what can I go out!"

Everyone exclaimed.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's figure appeared above the deserted city.

"Everyone."

Suddenly, everyone calmed down and looked up at Lu Daosheng's figure.

His eyes were full of respect.

Lu Daosheng continued, "Now, I have reached the All Spirit Realm. Next, I will tell you the basic knowledge in the All Spirit Realm. What should I do next, please choose your own choice."

He ignored whether to go or stay.

Immediately, a lot of information in the All Spirit Realm sounded from the minds of the people in the Huangcheng City.

These include the realm of the world of all spirits, power and some regional names.

When everyone learned about the realm system of the All Spirit Realm, they were completely confused.

In the invincible realm of reincarnation in the Hongmeng Universe, there is nothing in this world of all spirits.

Suddenly, everyone's excitement was poured into a basin of cold water.

I also hesitated to think about going out for a while.

More importantly, the outside world is full of alien races.

Their deserted city is actually the only human force in the world of all spirits.

If you go out, you will be bullied to death.

Forget it.

Everyone sat down again.

It’s better to take it with you in Huangcheng. By chance, you can go to Wanhualou for fun.

By the way, I heard that Wanhua Building has increased its price again.

But there are some brave people who are desperate and step out of the gate of the deserted city regardless of dissuasion.

However, after a while, the man came back with a look of contempt.

"Oh, brother, didn't you tell me to go out and have a chance? Why are you back so soon?"

The rest of the people were also looking at the person who had just left.

Hearing this, the man snorted and said contemptuously: "What kind of spirit world is not as good as the toilet environment in the city."

Hearing this, everyone was stunned and shook their heads in disappointment.

I didn't expect that the new world that I was looking forward to was so unbearable.

But this is no wonder that the world of spirits is because the configuration of the deserted city is really good.

Maybe looking at the heavens and the worlds, there is no place that is even more luxurious than here.

......

After a while, another notification rang out from the deserted city.

The aliens in the All Spirit Realm can also enter the deserted city to visit.

Hearing this, countless merchants in the deserted city became excited.

Then you must cheat those alien races?

People also began to look forward to it.

Although they do not have any discrimination between aliens, they are also quite curious about what those aliens look like.

Inside the main hall of the city lord’s mansion.

"Master, Sister Ouyang, Xiaoqing."

When they saw Lu Xue, the three of them were stunned.

The next moment, Ao Qing couldn't help but pounce on him.

"My little master, I'm sorry for you!"

Ao Qing said with tears in her eyes.

Ouyang Yanqing looked at Lu Xue with a guilty look on the side.

"Xiaoxue, it's my fault that I have made you wronged."

Hearing this, Lu Xue just shook her head lightly and didn't say much.

Now, she just wants to have a good rest.

Come here, just to see everyone.

Seeing Lu Xue's expression was a little haggard, Gu Chen said, "Xiaoxue, you go back and rest first."

Lu Xue nodded and left immediately.

After Lu Xue left, Gu Chen and the other two suddenly burst into a fierce aura.

Immediately, Gu Chen looked up at Lu Daosheng above.

"Master Lord, I wonder what grievances Xiaoxue has suffered in this world of all spirits?"

Gu Chen clasped his fists with both hands and said in a deep voice.

Ouyang Yanqing and Ao Qing also looked at Lu Daosheng, waiting for an answer.

Lu Xue's condition is very wrong.

They must have suffered grievances, so they naturally wanted to seek justice for Lu Xue.

Only Yun Qi and An Xing and others were unable to keep up with the rhythm, because Lu Daosheng did not tell them about this.

Looking at everyone below, Lu Daosheng's expression was also slightly deeper.

Taking a deep breath, Lu Daosheng finally informed them of Lu Xue’s experience in the Wanling Realm.

When he heard that the Supreme Elder of the Phoenix Clan had wanted Lu Xue in the All Spirit World for a hundred years, a terrifying murderous intent suddenly surged out of the people's bodies.

Ao Qing even cursed: "Fuck him, my ancestor! I know that this Phoenix Clan is not a good thing. From then on, my Dragon Clan and his Phoenix Clan will be broken off from each other!"

Gu Chen even said directly: "Master, please allow yourself to go to the Phoenix Clan."

In his tone, he was murderous.

Ouyang Yanqing on the side also echoed: "I'm there, I'll go too."

At this time, Yun Qi also sorted out these things and stepped forward and said, "Master Lord, do you have to send troops to the Phoenix Clan?"

At this moment, the Phoenix Clan seemed to have offended the lords of several major forces in the Huangcheng City to death.

Who is Lu Xue? That is the pearl in the palm of the Huangcheng City Lord.

They are too late to curry favor with each other, but they dare to be wanted, and it is still a hundred years old.

Never tolerate it.

Looking at the determination in everyone's eyes, Lu Daosheng shook his head slightly.

"No need, the Supreme Elder who issued the wanted order has been punished by me, and, after a while, the Phoenix Ancestor will come to the deserted city in person."

Hearing this, everyone was shocked.

The ancestor of the Phoenix tribe actually dared to come over.

For a moment, everyone was full of thoughts.
